characters.appearance: male, bearded, disheveled hair, facial injuries including bruising and blood, eyes open but unresponsive or dying
characters.actions: passive, possibly unconscious or near death

objects.name: blood
objects.position: on face and neck of character
objects.importance_for_reconstruction: high - key visual element defining state

camera.angle: slightly elevated, looking down at face
camera.composition: tight focus on facial features, shallow depth of field
camera.movement: static or minimal micro-movement across frames

sources: possible fill light from right side
lighting.intensity: moderate to high, creating strong highlights on wet surfaces
lighting.softness: mixed - some soft areas (skin), some hard speculars (blood)
lighting.shadows: subtle under chin and nose; shadows in eye sockets

visual_style.color_palette: dominated by reds, pinks, flesh tones, muted background
visual_style.contrast: low to medium contrast, desaturated except for blood highlights
visual_style.cinematic_characteristics: slow motion implied, focus on texture and detail

important_assets: human face geometry (high poly for skin texture)
blood particle system or shader-based blood layer
materials: wet skin material with subsurface scattering
blood material with viscosity and specular highlights
geometry: high-detail facial mesh including pores, wrinkles, injuries
displaced geometry for blood splatter effects
existing_assets: blood particle or fluid solver assets
